fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Hover-mechanized infantry ride hovercraft that can cover ground faster than any tracked or wheeled formation in the DCMS inventory. District commanders prize these platoons for rapid redeployment between garrison posts, and during the Jihad, hover-mechanized troops proved their worth in the kind of hit-and-run resistance operations that the Dictum Honorium demanded of citizens on occupied worlds. Armed with infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to hurl projectiles at extreme velocities. The longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers, though the weapons are expensive and maintenance-intensive enough that most commands reserve them for their best marksmen.
